title: Peaceweaver
excerpt: Peace Advocates Zamboanga invites all Young Peaceweaver and Peaceweaver (Adult) Awardees to an online Kamustahan and Dialogue on July 30, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM onwards. Message the Facebook page to receive the meeting link.
body:
Peace Advocates Zamboanga invites all Young Peaceweaver and Peaceweaver (Adult) Awardees to an online Kamustahan and Dialogue on July 30, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM onwards.

Let's catch up, celebrate our shared journey, and exchange ideas on how we can continue promoting peace in our communities.

Simply send a message to the ZABIDA Facebook page to receive the meeting link.
